sections.text: Introduction

This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by 
Y1 in the title block.

The easy set to check the condition of insulation of transformer is to inspect 
 the insulating oil.

When examination of oil samples will be performed periodically, changes of 
 insulation resistance, ageing of insulation oil, ingress of humidity or 
 beginning defects have been located by dissolved gas analysis could be 
 recognized in time.

For supervision of the insulation conditions we recommend a revision interval. 
 interior of the revision interval an improvement of the condition of the 
 insulation system when purifying the oil is possible.

Salah Kamel Mostafa: HV-Dep. Manager, tested by eng.

Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be 
 issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category.

Maintenance staff should be well trained and 
 qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy 
 equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 safety belt when cleaning 
 suspension insulators etc.

It is recommended to use only fiberglass PVC ladders when working in the 
 switchyard.

Taking out all circuit breakers 
 which connected to all sides of the transformer.
Disconnect supply of DC.

sections.text: Environmental Recommendation

items:
There is danger of falling into the oil containment pit when worked near large 
 power transformer

Before starting the cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of the transformers, 
 wear your breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items:
Complete 
 tool kit/set including a torque wrench tool.
Safety helmet, safety shoes, safety belt ... etc.
PVC ladder.
Voltage indicator, HV tester rod.

Fine cloth for cleaning purposes, 
 new silica-gel.
One or two stage oil purifying plant with min. flow rate of 1000 l/h and heating capacity of 100kw.
A vacuum pump set of minimum 100 m3/h.
A vacuum resistance oil pump of minimum 3000 l/m.
Heat exchanger of approx. 100 kw.

Two compartment for fuller earth filling which 
 can be filled alternately.

An oil tank of adequate size to contain the total 
 oil volume of the transformer which shall be purified.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Purification, Regeneration 
or new Oil Filling

items:
With respect to the interpretation of the tests results the following measures 
 could be necessary:
Purification of the oil and the insulation.
Regeneration of the oil.
New oil filling.

sections.text: Purification of the Oil

items: Purification means cleaning, drying and degassing of the oil.
The chemical condition of the oil will be changed.

sections.text: Regeneration of the Oil

In case of very aged oils purification is no more sufficient. Ageing products 
 have to be absorbed and removed. The regeneration of oil will be a 
 purification of oil with following fuller earth process and inhabitation.
New Oil Filling

items:
In case of results which indicate that a regeneration is not economical the 
 transformer has to be filled with new oil.

The process of "wash treatment" described below has been successfully 
 performed for many times.

It can be used for purification, regeneration and new oil filling with regard 
 to the sequence of the different processes.

sections.text: The wash Treatment
The main Characteristics

items: Heating the active core by hot oil when the transformer is under vacuum

Washing of ageing formation out of the active core by quick sucking of the oil 
 from the tank
Drying out of the active core during the following vacuum treatment
When regeneration the old oil:

sections.text: 1- Drying 2- Degassing 3- Fuller

4- Inhibition of the oil parallel to above mentioned treatment have to be 
 performed.
Remark:

For this processes the transformer tank has to be designed for 100% vacuum 
(pressure lower 1m bar)

in
the following sequence:

items: Suck the old oil.

Un tank of the transformer, cleaning with purified new oil and necessary 
 revision works to be done (on load tap changer, gasket, etc.)

Parallel to these works purification (fuller earth treatment ) and heating of 
 the old oil up to approx. 60oC interior of the circuit oil 
 purifying plant fuller earth plant oil tank.
Assemble the active core into the tank.
Heat insulate the transformer.
Evacuate the transformer.

Suck the worm oil into the transformer tank and heating of the active core by 
 oil within the circuit transformerheater transformer.

After heating of all parts of the transformer up to 80 ◦C the 
 oil has to be pumped off as quick as possible.

During the evacuation of the transformer the old oil with the ageing 
 formations which have been washed out in an earlier stage, will be purified 
 and treated with fuller earth. This process can be repeated, points (7 to 9), if it is necessary. The necessity has to be determined by check 
 measurements of the oil and the transformer.

Finally the purified, regenerated oil will be inhibited of 0.3% (2.6 
 ditertiary butyl para- kresol), to improve the stability against ageing.

The so purified, regenerated oil will be sucked under vacuum into the 
 transformer.

The above mentioned program includes all works which are necessary for 
 regeneration of old oil drying and cleaning of the active core.

Additional measures, as for transformer with high grade humid insulation, make 
 greater efforts with respect to the drying process necessary.

Because of the low diffusion coefficient of oil impregnated materials to 
 non impregnated materials, long drying periods of the inner insulation 
 layers will be necessary.

In this particular case drying out by use of a vacuum oven would be more 
 economically.

Work to be Carried Out
Purification, Regeneration 
or new Oil Filling
With respect to the interpretation of the tests results the following measures 
 could be necessary:
Purification of the oil and the insulation.
Regeneration of the oil.
New oil filling.
Purification of the Oil
Purification means cleaning, drying and degassing of the oil.
The chemical condition of the oil will be changed.
Regeneration of the Oil
In case of very aged oils purification is no more sufficient. Ageing products 
 have to be absorbed and removed. The regeneration of oil will be a 
 purification of oil with following fuller earth process and inhabitation.
New Oil Filling
In case of results which indicate that a regeneration is not economical the 
 transformer has to be filled with new oil.
The process of "wash treatment" described below has been successfully 
 performed for many times.
It can be used for purification, regeneration and new oil filling with regard 
 to the sequence of the different processes.
The wash Treatment
The main Characteristics
Heating the active core by hot oil when the transformer is under vacuum
Washing of ageing formation out of the active core by quick sucking of the oil 
 from the tank
Drying out of the active core during the following vacuum treatment
When regeneration the old oil:
1- Drying 2- Degassing 3- Fuller
4- Inhibition of the oil parallel to above mentioned treatment have to be 
 performed.
Remark:
For this processes the transformer tank has to be designed for 100% vacuum 
(pressure lower 1m bar)
